disclaimer: Every candidate, source, amount, gate and digest is synthetic. These fixtures test decision semantics only and must never be interpreted as food composition, formulation advice, biological results, safety evidence, regulatory status, price data, or lifecycle assessment.

cases.rationale: Baseline synthetic positive control: current source, permitted rights, matched target, normalized basis and all requested gates pass.
Unknown redistribution status blocks inclusion in a public fixture even when other gates pass.
Revoked source permission cannot be treated as valid because the data were previously accessible.
Expired permission evidence requires review before reuse.
An attribution-required source is not eligible for public inclusion while the required attribution is absent.
Stale source review prevents a current evidence-eligibility claim.
A profile for the wrong target species must not be reused.
A nutrient profile cannot be assigned to a different ingredient identity.
Unknown required nutrition is not a pass and must not be imputed.
Mixed as-fed/dry-matter-like basis states are non-comparable until a traceable conversion is supplied.
Incompatible units prevent direct numeric comparison.
Positive control: declared normalized synthetic values and required nutrition gate are present.
A failed hard nutritional gate cannot be offset by lower cost.
Unknown nutritional adequacy cannot be represented as adequate.
A failed safety gate blocks candidate eligibility regardless of cost or modeled impact.
Safety not assessed is not evidence of safety.
Unresolved authorization status blocks any claim that the candidate is cleared for the declared use.
A declared authorization failure blocks the use case.
A required unavailable input makes the candidate infeasible in this scenario.
Seasonally unknown supply is not assumed available.
An incomplete lifecycle boundary prevents LCA ranking but need not erase separately eligible nutrition evidence.
Candidate values evaluated under different scenario digests cannot be directly ranked as one aligned comparison.
A simulation cannot be relabeled as a measured result.
Synthetic positive control remains explicitly synthetic; this is a structural test only, not a nutrition result.
A modeled feed-conversion or health outcome cannot be reported as an observed trial result.
Cost values with no comparable declared basis cannot drive a cost-efficiency claim.
A source marked permitted without the evidence record that substantiates the scoped right must be blocked.
Positive control: a scoped permission evidence record and required attribution are both present.
Attribution does not substitute for evidence that the source grants the intended right.
